name: Islam
overview: Scripture acknowledges Ishmael as a son whose name means 'God shall hear,' highlighting God's awareness of his affliction (Genesis 16:11). However, the Bible centers on the person of Jesus Christ, the Word who was with God and is God, made flesh to reveal God's glory and truth (John 1:1, 14). Jesus Himself declares His identity clearly, emphasizing the necessity of faith in Him to avoid dying in sin (John 4:26; 8:24). Believers are called to respond with love and prayer even toward those who oppose them, reflecting Christ's teachings on loving enemies (Matthew 5:44).
